_doc: Forge V2 — Required-evidence gate, piece C2 (2026-07-18). Per project-type NON-NEGOTIABLE deliverables/checks to auto-inject into the PRD and Boss dispatch prompts, so a build can't quietly skip a domain's baseline (the repeated real ask: 'prove it, don't just say done'). Every entry is grounded in a REAL source: either FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md's per-domain working-principles bullet (quoted verbatim per requirement, same evidence discipline FORGE_STANDING_RULES.json uses) or ~/.claude/rules/ecc/.web-backup-prescope/{design-quality,testing}.md for the website anti-template + breakpoint detail. This file does NOT enforce anything by itself — it is read by the Lead/PRD step (forge-intake / forge-prd) to seed requirements text, and by required-evidence.json's companion forge-evidence.cjs to know what 'done' must be able to point to. Domain keys match forge-router SKILL.md Step 1's domain slugs exactly (website, fullstack, n8n, scraping, rag, prediction, integration) — do not invent a new slug here without also adding it to forge-router. Advisory/injection-only, matches this project's light-security governance (CLAUDE.md: 'no mandatory security gates') — nothing here blocks a run by itself; required-evidence.json + forge-evidence.cjs is the (also advisory) proof-side check.

requirements.text: No lorem ipsum or placeholder copy anywhere in the shipped build — real, final content only.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'Websites / landing / SPAs' bullet, verbatim: "real content (no lorem/placeholder)".

requirements.text: Responsive layout verified at desktop, tablet, and mobile — minimum breakpoints 320, 768, 1024, 1440.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'Websites / landing / SPAs' bullet, verbatim: "responsive desktop + tablet + mobile"; breakpoint set from ~/.claude/rules/ecc/.web-backup-prescope/testing.md 'Responsive' section, verbatim: "Test 320, 375, 768, 1024, 1440, 1920".

requirements.text: Nav, forms, and search implement loading, empty, and error states, not just the happy path.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'Websites / landing / SPAs' bullet, verbatim: "working nav/forms/search with loading + empty + error states".

requirements.text: Zero console errors in the browser at any verified breakpoint.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'Websites / landing / SPAs' bullet, verbatim: "zero console errors".

requirements.text: Accessibility basics covered: semantic HTML, color contrast, keyboard navigation.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'Websites / landing / SPAs' bullet, verbatim: "accessibility basics".

requirements.text: Intentional, non-template visual design — not a default Tailwind/shadcn/bootstrap look.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'Websites / landing / SPAs' bullet, verbatim: "intentional non-template design"; detail from ~/.claude/rules/ecc/.web-backup-prescope/design-quality.md 'Anti-Template Policy' section.

requirements.text: A real responsive screenshot check performed and reviewed before the build is called done.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'Websites / landing / SPAs' bullet, verbatim: "a screenshot check before calling it done".

requirements.text: Auth enforced server-side on every protected route — never client-side only.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'Full-stack apps' bullet, verbatim: "auth enforced server-side on every protected route".

requirements.text: Input validated at system boundaries before it is used.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'Full-stack apps' bullet, verbatim: "input validated at boundaries".

requirements.text: Secrets live in environment variables, with a matching placeholder added to .env.example — never hardcoded.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'Full-stack apps' bullet, verbatim: "secrets in env + .env.example".

requirements.text: DB migrations are reviewed and reversible.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'Full-stack apps' bullet, verbatim: "DB migrations reviewed + reversible".

requirements.text: Real end-to-end tests pass — not just unit tests.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'Full-stack apps' bullet, verbatim: "real e2e green".

requirements.text: An integration gate runs against the assembled app (boots clean, real flow works) — green unit tests alone are insufficient.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'Full-stack apps' bullet, verbatim: "an integration-gate on the assembled app (not just green unit tests)".

requirements.text: Webhook method, schema, and auth are validated.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'n8n / automations' bullet, verbatim: "validate webhook method/schema/auth".

requirements.text: An error branch plus retry/idempotency handling exists.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'n8n / automations' bullet, verbatim: "an error branch + retry/idempotency".

requirements.text: Production and test workflow/URLs are kept separate.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'n8n / automations' bullet, verbatim: "prod/test separation".

requirements.text: validate_workflow (or validate_node) is run and its output is clean or its real errors resolved.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'n8n / automations' bullet, verbatim: "run validate_workflow".

requirements.text: Imported/new workflows stay inactive until the owner explicitly approves activation.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'n8n / automations' bullet, verbatim: "import inactive-by-default".

requirements.text: Credentials are referenced as metadata only — never hardcoded secrets in files.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'n8n / automations' bullet, verbatim: "credentials as metadata only (no secrets in files)".

requirements.text: Never claim 'production-ready' without validation, and never live-activate without explicit owner approval.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'n8n / automations' bullet, verbatim: "never claim 'production-ready' without validation or live-activate without owner approval".

requirements.text: Only public, official, or explicitly permitted sources are scraped.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'Scraping / data' bullet, verbatim: "public / official / permitted sources only".

requirements.text: robots.txt is respected and rate limits are honored.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'Scraping / data' bullet, verbatim: "respect robots + rate limits".

requirements.text: No login/paywall/credential bypass, and no use of leaked data.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'Scraping / data' bullet, verbatim: "NO login/paywall/credential bypass or leaked-data use".

requirements.text: Any outreach drawn from scraped data is drafted-only — never auto-sent without explicit owner approval.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'Scraping / data' bullet, verbatim: "outreach is drafted-only unless the owner explicitly approves sending".

requirements.text: Answers are source-grounded with citations — never fabricated business facts.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'RAG / chatbots / AI voice agents' bullet, verbatim: "source-grounded answers with citations".

requirements.text: An honest fallback response exists for when the system is unsure — no hallucinated business facts.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'RAG / chatbots / AI voice agents' bullet, verbatim: "an honest fallback when unsure (no hallucinated business facts)".

requirements.text: Document ingestion is idempotent — re-running ingestion does not duplicate or corrupt the knowledge base.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'RAG / chatbots / AI voice agents' bullet, verbatim: "idempotent ingestion".

requirements.text: A human-handoff path exists for questions the system can't answer.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'RAG / chatbots / AI voice agents' bullet, verbatim: "human-handoff".

requirements.text: Lead capture, where present, is consent-aware.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'RAG / chatbots / AI voice agents' bullet, verbatim: "consent-aware lead capture".

requirements.text: Data sources are verified, not assumed or fabricated.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'Prediction / sports-data' bullet, verbatim: "verified data sources".

requirements.text: Real backtesting is performed and reported.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'Prediction / sports-data' bullet, verbatim: "real backtesting".

requirements.text: Every prediction/tip carries a mandatory uncertainty/confidence/risk label.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'Prediction / sports-data' bullet, verbatim: "mandatory uncertainty/confidence/risk labels".

requirements.text: Predictions never claim certainty.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'Prediction / sports-data' bullet, verbatim: "never claim certainty".

requirements.text: No automatic real-money betting is ever executed by the system.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'Prediction / sports-data' bullet, verbatim: "NO automatic real-money betting".

requirements.text: Webhook auth/signature checks are enforced on every incoming webhook.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'Telegram / bots / API integrations' bullet, verbatim: "webhook auth/signature checks".

requirements.text: OAuth scopes requested are minimal, not broad.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'Telegram / bots / API integrations' bullet, verbatim: "minimal OAuth scopes".

requirements.text: Retries, a dead-letter path, and clear errors exist for failed deliveries.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'Telegram / bots / API integrations' bullet, verbatim: "retries + dead-letter + clear errors".

requirements.text: Logging never leaks tokens or PII.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'Telegram / bots / API integrations' bullet, verbatim: "safe logging (never leak tokens/PII)".

requirements.text: Outreach/messages are drafted-only — never auto-sent without explicit owner approval.
requirements.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md per-domain principles, 'Telegram / bots / API integrations' bullet, verbatim: "outreach drafted-only / no auto-send".
